title: Old-Style Hammers
description: Changes the textures of axes to be hammers. Pre-1.14 style.
body:
This resource pack changes the texture of axes into a pre-1.14 styled hammer. Intended to be used with other programmer art-esque resource packs.

Doesn't change the names of the items, so they are still called "[XYZ Metal] Axe".

![The retextured copper axe being held by Steve Minecraft.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a92533c3d1487d576e6f373cfcad1de25f70af07.jpeg)
(The other textures are all from [Programmer Art Continuation Project](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pacp) and the base game Programmer Art!)
